ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels constituting the remaining 15% concentrated in linear marks and distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. High-contrast white linear vectors are distributed non-uniformly across the central and lateral regions of both lobes against a solid dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and high vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude jagged serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary, with prominent irregular protrusions at the mid-point of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward convex sweep toward the distal tips, originating from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-intensity white circular pixel clusters localized strictly to the left and right terminal points (tips) of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations across the dark ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white linear scarring across the central ventral surface and prominent barnacle colonization on the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and deeply serrated trailing edge profile, exhibiting significant deviation from a smooth curve.
